limitations_and_noncausal_interpretation: Selected checkpoint training gains establish fit of the selected snapshot, not the full per-epoch optimizer trajectory.
Epoch0 fallback is explained exactly by the saved validation comparison, not by a numerical stopping-tolerance effect.
Generalization failure and shifting factor/label scales are observed; causation by distribution shift, estimator variance, misspecification, or insufficient information is not identified.
Comparisons across architectures/markets/years are descriptive and cannot justify a newly selected market, horizon, seed, stopping epoch or threshold.
126 validation origins are overlapping labels: at most 26 disjoint H5 windows or 7 disjoint H20 windows, not 126 independent replications.
Changing to a three-state multi-horizon mixture has not been trained or validated by this diagnostic; latent states would be statistical states, not identified policy/market mechanisms.
